{{Quote|Then tell Lando to start the tournament now, and have Eloa wire Senator Treen's entry fee back to her.|Booster Terrik to [[Saliah]]|<ref name="Vortex" />}}
'''Eloa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] of an unidentified species serving [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Booster Terrik]] aboard the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' in [[44 ABY]]. During the first ever [[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]], Eloa was tasked to wire [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]]'s entry fee of one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] back, as Treen's place in the tournament was being assumed by [[Wynn Dorvan]], personal assistant to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]].<ref name="Vortex" />
